stable.headline: Shadows, better car paint, a smarter Quick remesh, and scenes that come back as saved
notes: Shadows: the sun casts shadows on the parts and a soft one on the floor (Scene > Shadows).
Quick remesh reduces like Blender: flat faces joined, every second line of a ring grid dissolved, then cut evenly again. It works on OBJ files too.
A saved scene leads Recent and comes back as it was: materials, paint colour, units, grid, lights, locks and the explode amount.
Change pivot orientation, Hide and Isolate as switches, and pasting a folder of the tree as one group.
Car paint presets with a faint flake shimmer, and a Keep texture coordinates switch on import.
Remove holes with Ctrl+Z in a loop no longer runs out of memory; Undo waits for a running step; closing Quick remesh mid-way no longer freezes the page.
A slimmer loading card with a time estimate for STEP files, and Settings > Performance > Memory.
